rows.text:
A handwritten note with shaky, uneven scrawls. The writer's excitement over its contents practically bleeds through every crooked stroke.

The existence of intelligent life ought not to remain trapped in its present biological state like a tadpole.
The evolution of intelligent life ought not to surrender to pure natural randomness like a fallen leaf.
The evolution of intelligent life ought not to be shackled by self-repetition and gradual decay like an echo.

The natural evolution of intelligent life is woefully inefficient. We will forge perfect life with our very own hands.

A perfect life form ought not to abandon the instinct to live for the sake of thought.
A perfect life form ought not to lose its room to evolve due to its environment.
A perfect life form ought not to perish because of cellular aging.
A perfect life form ought not to be bound by limitation.
A perfect life form can comprehend all things.
